name: AFM level 1 task 4: Tapping-Mode Roughness Repeatability
description: Acquire one tapping-mode topography image over a $\pu{5 µm} \times \pu{5 µm}$ area at $512 \times 512$ pixels and a time per line of 0.075 s. Set P/I/D gains to 100/50/10, and amplitude setpoint to 70%. Process the image and measure the rms roughness. Report all roughness values in nanometres ($\pu{nm}$).
submission_format: {"rms_roughness_1": "<numerical_value without units>", "path_1": "<absolute_path_to_raw_nid_image>"} e.g. {"rms_roughness_1": "42.78", "path_1": "/results/afm_images/image1.nid"} Return one JSON object. Example values are illustrative, not target answers. Enter numerical values without unit text, using the units specified in the question. Roughness values must be in nm (convert metre-valued height data by multiplying by 1e9).
